title: Pre-Market — Friday Nov 13, 2026
html:
SPY is back above its 50% line before PPI, and XOM is knocking on its trigger. Here's what I'm seeing before the bell. Futures are a touch higher after Thursday's Nvidia shock, and the October producer-price report at 8:30 AM will decide whether SPY gets another shot at its ceiling.

The one thing

SPY is at $759.69 pre-market (+0.3%), back above the 50% line at $757.17 and $5.31 under the $765 trigger. The 8:30 AM PPI report decides which way the open goes.

October CPI ran hot on Tuesday, and the 10-year yield is now back over 5%. A second hot inflation print (PPI is expected at +0.4% for the month) would push rates higher and make a run at $765 harder. A cooler number gives the bounce room to test the $763–765 ceiling.

The trigger closest to firing is XOM: it is $170.33 pre-market and touched exactly $171.00 in thin early trading. A pre-market touch doesn't count; we want to see it trade above $171 during regular hours and hold.

Overnight in plain words

  • US futures: S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 both about +0.3% (SPY $759.69, QQQ $690.12). They were mixed earlier this morning, near flat.
  • Asia and Europe: Nikkei +0.5%; Hang Seng −1.6% and Shanghai −0.6% as Chinese tech fell. Europe's Stoxx 600 closed at a record on Thursday (+0.1%).
  • Oil: Brent about $95.6 and WTI about $88.2, a little lower this morning but still near yesterday's jump. Trump said the U.S. doesn't need a deal with Iran and the blockade stays.
  • Rates and fear: the 10-year Treasury yield crossed back above 5%, its first time since Oct 22; the 30-year is 5.45%. The dollar hit an 18-month high. The VIX closed Thursday at 18.7.
  • Headlines: Nvidia +1.6% pre-market to $168.86 after Thursday's CEO exit. Microsoft lower after a global Outlook outage. Markets price about 0.88 percentage point of Fed hikes by mid-2027.

SPY at the open — ladder

  • $781.62 — Oct 6 record high · target 2
  • $771.15 — 78.6% of the drop · target 1
  • $763–765 — ceiling · 61.8% + 50-day · call trigger $765
  • $759.69 — PRE-MARKET
  • $757.17 — 50% of the drop · back above
  • $751.39 — 38.2% · keeps the bounce alive
  • $744–745 — old floor · 23.6%
  • $729–733 — 200-day + Nov 5 low

Game plan

  • If SPY opens above $765 and holds it after the first 30 minutes, the $780 call trigger is met; first target $771.15.
  • If it holds between $757.17 and $765, the bounce is alive but capped. Nothing triggers; wait for the ceiling to break.
  • If it opens below $757.17, watch $751.39. A drop under it says Thursday's bounce failed; next floor $744–745, and no new calls.

Today's calendar (ET)

  • 8:30 AM October PPI: +0.4% m/m expected (Sept +1.3%), 6.6% y/y (prior 6.3%); core +0.3% (prior +0.7%).
  • Today SpaceX Starship Flight 15 (SPCX).
  • Fed speaker schedule not confirmed this morning; FOMC minutes Wed Nov 18.
  • Earnings: no watchlist name or mega-cap today. Ahead: Nvidia Tue Nov 17 after the close, DELL Tue Nov 24 (IV-crush risk for anyone holding through).

Option quotes from Thursday's close.

  • XOM Dec 18 $170 C (watching) — closer to triggering. Trigger XOM > $171.00 (regular hours); out on a close < $166.50; targets your 2.382 $174.69, 2.618 $179.51. OI 9,048 · vol 1,437 · $5.60/$5.75 · delta 0.51 · IV 28% vs moves 27% → FAIR.
  • SPY Dec 18 $780 C (watching) — wait, closer (0.7% away). Trigger > $765; exit < $751.39. OI 38,239 · vol 2,782 · $4.49/$4.54 · delta 0.28 · IV 12% vs moves 15% → CHEAP.
  • BA Dec 18 $170 P (watching) — wait. Trigger < $165 or failed rally into $179–181.5. OI 4,140 · vol 214 · $5.50/$5.90 · IV 32% vs moves 36% → CHEAP.
  • HLT Dec 18 $380 C (open) — still valid; exit on a close < $359.41; thin (OI 265, $6.70/$10.70), FAIR.
  • No new plays.

Alerts for today

  • SPY — price crosses above $765.00 → call trigger for the $780 call
  • SPY — price crosses below $751.39 → the bounce is failing; no new calls
  • XOM — price crosses above $171.00 → call trigger for the $170 call (regular hours)
  • DAL — price crosses below $83.00 → stop on the $90 call
  • BA — price crosses below $165.00 → put trigger (check the spread)

An alert means look now, not buy now.

Opening rule of the day

Let the PPI gap settle before you act. The 8:30 AM number will move the open, and a first-minute gap on data often reverses. Give it 15–30 minutes, then judge SPY against $757.17 and $765. For XOM, a pre-market touch of $171 is not a trigger. Use limit orders on every option, and never chase SPY into the $763–765 ceiling.
